items.description: Remove and dispose of damaged bathroom tiles
items.rationale: The bathtub supply leak qualifies as escape of water under §2.4.2, and §7.1.7(a) covers removal and disposal of the affected finish. All 6 m² were wet; at roughly €40/m² gross, the estimate is €240.

items.description: Supply and install bathroom floor tiles
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.1(b), 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like reinstatement of all 6 m². At about €115/m² gross for ordinary tiles, bedding and installation, the estimate is €690.

General cleaning is excluded under §7.1.8(a), and the line includes unaffected areas barred by §7.1.5. The conditional estimate of €180 is for an ordinary apartment clean, not an allowance under the policy.

items.description: Prepare and paint damaged lower wall
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(b) cover repainting and necessary preparation of the documented stained wall area. At €25/m² gross for 20 m², the estimate is €500.

The ceiling was checked and found undamaged, so §7.1.5 excludes painting it; it is not part of the same continuous surface as the damaged wall under §7.1.6. The conditional estimate is 15 m² at €15/m² gross.
The hallway was unaffected, so §§7.1.5–7.1.6 exclude the work even if it was done alongside covered repairs. The conditional estimate is 8 m² at €25/m² gross.
The swollen laminate is an insured floor finish under §4.2.2, and §7.1.7(a) covers its necessary removal. At €13/m² gross for 18 m², the estimate is €234.

Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like laminate and underlay, with no allowance for an acoustic upgrade or newly added layer. At €58/m² gross for 18 m² of standard reinstatement, the estimate is €1,044.
Sections 4.2.2 and 7.1.5 cover replacement of fixed trim along the affected run. The supplied gross threshold prior for the full 25 linear metres is €3,098.
